reader.notes: TerminateCore presents the PF before the RF; an RF with LINE NEXT PAGE then takes its own bare PageFeed, so its page has no PF, and the RH NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE feed in ApplyNextGroup has no PF before it. Body-group page advances go through AdvancePage (PF, feed, PH).
